title: Aerothermal Engineer, Rolls-Royce
short_description: A CFD verification and validation study on novel HP turbine cooling geometry, prompting a company re-assessment of current CFD methodology.
full_description: A computational verification and validation study on novel high-pressure turbine cooling geometry at Rolls-Royce, using STARCCM+ to run test cases and MATLAB to post-process results against experimental boundary conditions.
methodology: Ran CFD test cases in STAR-CCM+ on novel HP turbine cooling geometry, refining parameters to match experimental boundary conditions, then used MATLAB scripts to post-process the data for validation against experiment.
results: The validation work resulted in company discussions re-assessing current CFD methodologies used for turbine blades.
